svg.title: Timing constants on a log axis
svg.desc: 105 timing constants span 100 ms to 365 d; reference lines mark Heartbeat stale (sn-be-t-heartbeat-stale), Job lease (sn-be-t-lease-default), Job stall (sn-fe-t-stall), Token lifetime (ml-t-tidal-user-default). n = 105 timing constants. State: Projected. Source: findings.json timings[].
